result.summary: Restricts descriptor expansion in `DescriptorScriptPubKeyMan::TopUpWithDB()` to start at `range_start` instead of index 0, and records the derived index directly rather than incrementing an offset from -1. Also aligns `DescriptorScriptPubKeyMan::Load()` to set `m_max_cached_index` to the actual index loaded.
result.problem: When importing a descriptor with range `[N, M]`, the wallet expands and tracks keys starting from index 0 instead of `N`. This causes import times to scale with M rather than the range size M - N, falsely treats scriptPubKeys below N as `IsMine` until wallet restart (causing rescanned transactions below N to lose ownership on reload), can trigger derivation of up to 2^31 keys for high range starts, and causes redundant re-expansions on active wallet reload due to miscalculated `m_max_cached_index`.
evidence: Author benchmark: 'Importing wpkh(xpub/0/*) with "range": [600000, 600009] into a blank watch-only wallet goes from 19.5s to 0.09s on this machine.' (PR description)

Author notes vulnerability to excessive derivation: 'Since ParseDescriptorRange() only bounds the size of the range and not its start, "range": [2146483648, 2147483647] is accepted and expands 2^31 indexes into m_map_script_pub_keys before the RPC returns.' (PR description)
result.changed_since_previous: No functional differences; patch rebased or re-formatted.
result.card: Bounds descriptor key expansion during import top-ups to start at range_start rather than index 0, and records the derived index directly. Currently, importing a descriptor with range [N, M] derives and caches all keys from 0 to M, making import cost O(M) instead of O(M - N) and causing keys below N to appear as owned during import only to disappear when the wallet is reloaded. The author reports that importing a 10-key range starting at index 600,000 drops from 19.5 seconds to 0.09 seconds, and prevents pathological large range starts from attempting to derive up to 2^31 keys.

risk.why: Flaws in descriptor address derivation or caching could cause wallets to fail to detect incoming transactions or misreport wallet ownership.
